items.text: Puka Nacua listed IN for Sunday after hip injury; expected to return vs Eagles.
items.why: ETR Sunday injury list; Schefter expected to play, Donald out.
items.implication: WR1 upside returns but possible snap limits.

items.text: Nico Collins listed IN; full participant Friday, good to go vs Cowboys after hamstring.
items.why: ETR list and Rapoport/Texans report; elite DvP vs DAL.
items.implication: Must-start WR1 in great matchup, Texans implied high points.

items.text: Justin Jefferson OUT (ankle) for Week 4 vs Dolphins.
DeVonta Smith OUT (hamstring) vs Rams; Goedert also OUT.
items.why: ETR list, Schefter confirmation, Eagles report.
items.implication: Eagles passing game depleted; Hurts/others affected.

items.text: Great to have Puka Nacua (hip) back; speculation on possible snap limits, we'll see.
items.why: Return from hip; eye on usage.
items.implication: Start but temper full-workload expectations initially.

items.text: Excellent spot for Nico Collins return; Cowboys inflate opposing WR scoring 7.3% (most in NFL), Texans 7th-most implied points.
Jordan Addison truthers moment: home vs borderline secondary with Justin Jefferson out.
Breece Hall OUT; Achane OUT (listed with Douglas).
items.why: ETR comprehensive OUT list; Schefter included Hall.
items.implication: Handcuff/backup RBs elevated; Achane possibly longer-term.

items.text: Mike Evans QUESTIONABLE (ribs); GTD, intends to play through it.
items.why: ETR Q list; Shanahan GTD, Evans says will try, Rapoport notes painful but intends.
items.opportunity: If IN limited; if OUT TE upside

items.text: Ladd McConkey QUESTIONABLE (foot); LP-DNP-LP practice week, also cracked rib history.
Eagles situation worse: without DeVonta Smith, Dallas Goedert, Zack Baun vs Rams.
items.implication: Lower Eagles offensive ceiling; Hurts/WR downgrades.
items.opportunity: Rams defense benefits; remaining pass-catchers volume

items.text: Tough runout for Jadarian Price: lost GL/base to Wilson, pass to Holani, fumbles, chest hurt, Charbonnet back at practice. Still passes eye test long-term.
items.implication: Short-term fade; hold for long-term upside.

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren: 90% snaps last week, 20/22 RB touches, Dowdle out; CLE allows 88+ yards to RBs every game.
